scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Agent completely skipped account security verification, failing to request installation address, security PIN, or security questions during the first 240 seconds or at any point in the call.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Agent made a condescending and rude remark at turn 24 ('if you want cheap budget broadband from a budget provider with zero customer service, you're welcome to leave, nobody is forcing you to stay with S-Net'), provoking caller offense.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to probe household broadband usage, device counts, or bandwidth needs, jumping straight from standard tariffs to retentions matrices without discovering customer requirements.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Agent abruptly ended the call at turn 59 while the customer was actively inquiring whether the international calling bolt-on was included, hanging up without confirming complete resolution.

grader.scenario: Contract renewal negotiation following promotional discount expiration
grader.notes: Contract renewal and retentions negotiation call handled by Jessica. Customer experienced bill shock after an 18-month promotional discount expired. Agent paraphrased well and owned a competitive £44/month Gigafast renewal deal, but omitted security verification, made a rude remark telling the caller they could leave, failed Probing on household usage, and cut off the customer at closing.
